title: 2b-R: emergency revocation runbook for a leaked supervisor or turn credential
description:
Contract: docs/OWNER_CREDENTIAL_RENEWAL.md (decision S6, sections 7.1, 12.2, 12.3, 17 R). Documentation only; no production code.

Write docs/OWNER_CREDENTIAL_REVOCATION.md: what to do when a supervisor credential or a per-turn credential leaks, in order, each step with its cost, who may do it and how to verify it: (1) stop the task (aws ecs stop-task; the owner reports stopped and the control plane then refuses its token because the owner is no longer the live owner); (2) revoke the role session with an inline deny on ComputerSupervisorRole and ComputerOwnerScopedRole carrying an aws:TokenIssueTime condition, as a CDK change deployed by the normal path and never by hand in the console (it affects every tenant's sessions of that role; live owners recover at their next renewal because a new session has a later issue time); (3) rotate the signing key secret (invalidates every supervisor, bootstrap and gateway token at once; owners then exit 5 and publish nothing, so it is the last resort and the document states what unpublished work is lost); (4) after the incident remove the deny and check CloudTrail AssumeRole events and the owner_credentials_refreshed log lines to bound what was reachable. Cite the blast-radius analysis of 12.2. No account id (those live only in AGENTS.local.md). Link it from docs/THREAT_MODEL.md and from section 12.3 of the contract.

Acceptance: the document exists; every command in it was run read-only or as a dry run on development where possible (the CDK deny is synthesized, not deployed); a second reader followed it once; a Kanbus comment records the result.

Dependencies: none. Blocks nothing.

comments.text: Second read done 2026-10-20 on development (read-only, nothing deployed, no secret rotated). PR 623 merged. Per step: 0.1 shell setup - CORRECTED (hard-coded role, Lambda and log-group names were from the retired development account; now derived from CloudFormation). 1.1 sts identity with a leaked file - syntax worked with a credential-free file; real leaked credential NOT EXERCISABLE. 1.2 logs start-query - CORRECTED (broker/starter log groups are truncated names; supervisor lines live in the ComputerLogs group; no rows exist, development has no owner lines); ECS cluster selector CORRECTED (old selector matched production ChatticusComputers-Cluster, so stop-task could have hit production). 2.1 suspend - route and gate worked (wrong bearer gives 403), success path NOT EXERCISABLE (mutates). 2.2 stop-task - NOT EXERCISABLE (no development owner task running); text corrected: an ECS stop does not make the owner report stopped, the control plane settles it after the 30 s heartbeat window. 3 deny - CORRECTED (2b is live: impairment lasts until the next scheduled renewal, up to about 40 min, not one failed request); simulator dry run worked (explicitDeny for old session, allowed for new); CDK deny SYNTHESIZED (two AWS::IAM::Policy resources, not deployed); live deny and broker-not-locked-out NOT EXERCISABLE (U1 open). 3.4 list-role-policies and simulate-role-access (42 of 42) worked. 4 tokens - worked (code read). 5 signing key - list-secret-version-ids worked; put command CORRECTED (pipe stored a trailing newline); rotation and recycle NOT EXERCISABLE (destructive); 401 invalid_credential probe with a made-up token worked on development. 6 invoke key dry run worked. 7 removal - list-role-policies worked, delete NOT EXERCISABLE. 9 audit - DynamoDB queries, lookup-events, describe-trails worked (empty: no trail in the account, no rows). 10.1 acceptance runner - CORRECTED (it does not exercise a computer turn). U1-U13 updated: U4, U5, U8, U9, U10, U11, U13 resolved. The two differences resolved: (1) contract S6 says the deny is a CDK change, runbook offered a CLI deny - now the CDK change is documented and synthesized, CLI kept as a recorded exception until the switch is built; (2) contract 12.3 said one failed request per owner, code renews on a clock and the runbook was written around a 2a/2b split - runbook now states 2b only and 12.3 corrected. Gaps filed or linked: chatticus-c06de6 (CDK switch), chatticus-ebf08a (operator stop route), chatticus-541dc7 (signing key rotation script, existing). Acceptance met (document exists, commands run read-only or dry-run, deny synthesized, second reader followed once, this comment); closing.
